name: Off-Highway Motorcycle
description: An off-highway vehicle that is a motorcycle designed primarily for off-highway use, such as an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden on trails.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle designed for use primarily off-highway; no limit on motor power or speed

An electric one's sellers must disclose at sale and in any advertising, website or social media post, in bold capitals at least the size of its description, that it is not an electric assisted bicycle but a motor vehicle subject to motor vehicle laws, and that insurance may not cover it

An electric one's commercial sellers must disclose at sale and in any advertising, website or social media post, in bold capitals, that it is not an electric assisted bicycle but a motor vehicle subject to motor vehicle laws, that a helmet may be required, and that insurance may not cover it
restrictions.citation: Utah Code §§41-6a-1115.5(8), 41-6a-1511(6), as amended and enacted by H.B. 381 (2026)

restrictions.rule: Registered with the Division of Motor Vehicles each year, with a registration decal and card kept with it, to ride or place it on any public land, trail, street or highway
Every operator must complete a Division of Outdoor Recreation OHV education course to ride on public lands: a full safety course under 18, or a free one-time online course at 18 and older
Riders must be able to reach and work every control, and a rider under 18 with no driver's license riding on a public highway open to motor vehicles must be directly supervised by someone 18 or older
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a DOT-rated helmet on public land
Not allowed on a street or highway unless it is designated open to off-highway vehicles, except to cross it, load or unload, or in an emergency
May be registered as street legal if it meets the inspection and insurance requirements; otherwise, riding it on public roads needs motorcycle registration, insurance and a driver's license
May not be ridden on someone else's private land without the owner's permission
